H10_ordering_is_preserved.statement: the ranking of deployable arms by A_s under independent_window on the change metric agrees with the ranking under paired_crn on the point metric at Spearman rho >= 0.7

H8_prime.excluded_because: mean energy_as == 0 over this campaign's rows
H8_prime.falsifier: the paired_crn control is not flat over the excited arms, in which case phase one's diagnosis of its own saturation was incomplete; or either broken level stays flat, in which case breaking the pairing did not break the saturation
H8_prime.statement: restricted to arms with non-zero mean injected energy, A_s on the change metric is constant across arms under paired_crn (spread <= 0.05) and is not constant under independent_seed and independent_window (spread > 0.05)

H8_saturation_is_a_design_artifact.falsifier: the change metric stays saturated, in which case the saturation is not a design artifact
H8_saturation_is_a_design_artifact.statement: under independent_seed and independent_window, A_s on the change metric is no longer constant across arms: at least one deployable arm differs from another by more than 0.05

vacuity.why: P0_passive injects no energy, so it resolves nowhere and scores A_s = 0 at every level including the control. The spread between it and any excited arm is ~1.0 by construction, so this statistic cannot come out any other way and its verdict above carries no information.

H9_change_metric_recovers_plant_structur.falsifier: breaking the cancellation does not recover plant structure
H9_change_metric_recovers_plant_structur.statement: under independent_window, median |e_dR| differs across Q0, Q1 and Q2 by at least a factor of two, where under paired_crn all three are equal to within 5%
